title: Better Crafting Recipes
description: Makes the building blocks' crafting recipes feel more consistent.
body:
Better Crafting Recipes changes a lot of the crafting recipes in the game to be consistant with each other. (ex. the stairs crafting recipes give 6 stairs instead of 4 to align better with the smithing table)

Fully compatible with [Mortar (and Pastels)](https://modrinth.com/mod/mortar).
